title: Selection Is Not Learning: Choosing Model Futures
abstract: arXiv:2610.22029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-evolving language models train on tasks they generate, so every round must decide which updated model the next round inherits. Current loops such as R-Zero, Agent0, and Skill Self-Play make this decision through the task, admitting tasks that look learnable and inheriting every resulting update. We identify a selection-to-update gap in these loops, where a task that looks learnable need not produce a useful update. Most updates on verified tasks fail to make correct answers more likely, yet these loops inherit them all. HeirCommit freezes the updated model and uses fresh evaluation questions to decide whether to inherit it or retain the current model. EvoHeir separates parameter inheritance from experience inheritance, using current and archived experience to repair failures and preserve successes before final confirmation. translated_title: 选择并非学习：为模型抉择未来
translated_abstract: 自进化语言模型在自身生成的任务上进行训练，因此每一轮都必须决定下一轮将继承哪个更新后的模型。当前的循环方法（如 R-Zero、Agent0 和 Skill Self-Play）通过任务来做出这一决定：接受那些看起来可学习的任务，并继承由此产生的所有更新。我们在这些循环中发现了一个“选择到更新的差距”（selection-to-update gap）：一个看起来可学习的任务未必会带来有用的更新。在经过验证的任务上，大多数更新并不能使正确答案更可能出现，然而这些循环仍然将其全部继承。HeirCommit 冻结更新后的模型，并使用全新的评估问题来决定是继承该模型还是保留当前模型。EvoHeir 则将参数继承与经验继承分离开来，在最终确认之前，利用当前和存档的经验来修复失败并保留成功。我们的分析刻画了由选择引起的乐观偏差，并将遗憾分解为选择、吸收和……
tldr: 自进化语言模型中“看起来可学习的任务”并不等于“有用的模型更新”，本文提出 HeirCommit 与 EvoHeir 方法，通过冻结评估和参数-经验分离式继承来弥合选择与更新之间的差距。
en_tdlr: In self-evolving language models, a task that looks learnable does not guarantee a useful update; the paper proposes HeirCommit and EvoHeir to bridge the selection-to-update gap via frozen-model evaluation and decoupled parameter-experience inheritance.
